tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
All Conditions as per Tender Document Uploaded

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Copy of at least three similar work orders dated on or before 01.01.2026 obtained from any election conducting authority or Agreements signed dated on or before 01.01.2026with CEO, Karnataka / any RO or DEO in Karnataka for any similar IT Services in the last five years should be submitted. Alternatively, one similar work order dated on or before 01.01.2026 obtained from any election conducting authority or Agreement signed dated on or before 01.01.2026 with the ECI / CEO, Karnataka / any RO or DEO in Karnataka for any similar IT Service of equivalent value in the last five years should be submitted.
Bidder should have an average annual turnover of 50% of bid value (or as specified) and above in the last three (2023-2024, 2024-25& 2025-26) audited financial years.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Audited CA Certificate of Annual Turnover

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Copy of the ITR for the last 3 years should be submitted.
Copies of the Audited balance sheet for the last 3 financial years should be submitted

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Audited CA Certificate of Annual Turnover

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Certificate from the Chartered Accountant should be enclosed with positive Net worth in the last three financial years of 2023-24, 2024-25 & 2025-26

Bidder should be a registered entity with Department of Registrar of Companies registered in India under the Companies Act 1956 or 2013. Bidder should have been in the Web Casting / Information Technology/ IT enabled services/ Telecommunication business/ Video Recording Services/Internet Service Provider for 3 (three) Years as on 01/01/2026.Copy of the Registration with Taxation Department/ Certificate of incorporation should be submitted.

The Bidder should not hold any sanction/ black-listing by any Government/ Quasi government agency during the past 3 years (even if the sanction / black-list was subsequently withdrawn).Self-declaration Certificate / Affidavit as prescribed should be submitted.

The Bidder should have at least 10 (Ten) sufficiently skilled personnel having requisite experience in the field of webcasting. Self-declaration on the company letter head in respect of current year to be provided.
Upload all Appendix/Forms and supporting documents related to technical bid qualification only given in tender documents
